translations.web: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.
translations.bsb: As for their appearance, all four had the same form, like a wheel within a wheel.
translations.kjv: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
translations.asv: And as for their appearance, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel have been within a wheel.
